name: Alternating Side Toe Touch
steps: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip-width and reach both arms straight overhead.
Bend smoothly sideways toward one foot, letting your arms sweep down toward your toes while keeping your legs straight.
Hold briefly at a comfortable stretch along your opposite side while breathing steadily.
Sweep your arms back overhead as you stand tall, then continue alternating smoothly between sides for the target duration.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward rather than collapsing straight down over your thighs.
Soften your knees slightly if your hamstrings feel overly tight.
